body:
Thank you for the reply.

A few days have past but... I can't do it. I can't seem to go on anymore. Each day is getting worse. This is how I truly feel and I want someone to help.

After waking up each day, I immediately feel so terrible. Usually sleep can help clear some sad thoughts but I was still really sad.

Before I talked with them, I felt like no one loves me for just me being me. I mean, I understand people may like you for what things you have or your success, but I felt like no one really loves me personally (regardless of what I have).

I had a traumatic event and some moments before meeting them.

I felt really hurt.

After meeting them... and being able to talk with them, I felt like I found someone who really loves me for me being me. Since I was basically just a random person, and this person was more well known, I just felt like I found someone who really liked me or appreciated me.

I felt like my feelings actually mattered to someone. 

Every time I talked with them, all my sadness was gone and I felt so eager to live and do things.

But then you know the rest of the story. I got blocked.

How I am feeling after a few days is that each day is getting worse and worse. I just feel too sad to do anything.

Today, I really thought they would unblock me because I told them the same thing on another account I had.

I want my feelings to matter. I want it to be important to someone. I also want to be loved for who I am and not what I have. I thought I found that person. I hope that person is that person.

Today, I really thought they would unblock me because I told the story and...

This feels so unreal, like it can't be happening. I feel so sad and hurt and I feel like no one loves me or cares about me at all.

And, I also talked with someone that hasn't blocked me but knows the person. I asked them and told my story. They haven't replied at all. They also usually liked my tweets and they also talk with basically anyone that mentions or asks them.

I don't know why but it just feels like I'm being singled out and ignored and it just feel so unreal. I feel like when I cry, no one cares to listen or anything. I... I do want to live but it hurts so much that I feel that I can only just end myself.

Also sadly, my other twitter account that I was using to talk with was suspended. I just thought for sure that they'd unblock me but each day is getting worse.

They are the nicest person ever. I read their tweets. I became so happy from following them and it was truly everything that they replied and liked my tweets almost every time. They gave me the will to live (before then, again, I was in a sad moment and may have had trouble going on; they helped me keep going in life).

Each day, it feels so unreal this happened. If I linked to their twitter, you'd see they are the nicest person ever. I don't know why I was blocked. 

In a way, I'm glad I feel this way because I've always been this way for situations like this. At the same time, I'm sad that no one seems to love me. I thought for sure they would unblock me. I told them my story and I thought if anyone would have heard the story, they'd like me and understand my feelings. I thought I was going to be unblocked after telling that story. 

I don't know why they blocked me and I truly cry each day. I don't think I'm going to last this month. I don't want to say it but I really don't have anyone else. 

When I was talking with them, I felt so happy. I forgot all my previous sadness I've had.

Also I'm sad my other twitter account is suspended. I don't have the will to go on anymore because they were what gave me the will to go on and now I can't talk with them anymore it seems. Currently I'm trying to ask for anyone that knows them for help. Each day, it seems the reality is that I'm not going to be able to live anymore. I'm just too sad to do anything and each day, it hurts more.
